name: Bounty on Murlocs
summary: In eastern Elwynn, murlocs are spreading, and the Stormwind Army has set a bounty on them. With the garrison stretched thin, Guard Thomas turns to travelers to clear camps around Stone Cairn Lake and the southern waterways before murlocs overrun nearby farms and roads.

sections.title: A Threat on the Waterways
sections.body: Murlocs have made camps around Stone Cairn Lake and along the fork of the southern streams. Lurkers and foragers attack travelers and press toward human settlements. What began as a small nuisance now threatens eastern Elwynn, though the western roads remain comparatively secure.

sections.title: Stretched Defenses
sections.body: Guard Thomas is stationed at the eastern bridge beside the Redridge Mountains. Dangers beyond the bridge and disorder at home both call for his attention. King Varian Wrynn is missing, and bureaucracy weighs on Stormwind's military command. Town garrisons rarely receive the reinforcements they request. So Marshal Dughan and local officers offer public bounties, paying coin for murloc fins to slow the attacks along the waterways.

faq.q: Why is there a bounty on murlocs in Elwynn?
faq.answer: Murlocs have growing camps around Stone Cairn Lake and the southern streams of eastern Elwynn. Their foraging parties threaten nearby farms, roads, and travelers, so the Stormwind Army pays travelers to cull their numbers.

faq.q: Who is paying for the bounty?
faq.answer: The Stormwind Army funds the bounty through Goldshire's command under Marshal Dughan. Guard Thomas is the field contact at the eastern river crossing and pays travelers.

faq.q: Where are the murloc settlements located?
faq.answer: Murloc camps line the shores and islands of Stone Cairn Lake to the north. To the south, they follow the riverbanks where the eastern stream forks.

faq.q: Why can't the Stormwind guards handle this themselves?
faq.answer: Stormwind's military is stretched thin across the kingdom by political strife, missing leadership, and banditry. Outposts like Guard Thomas's bridge have only a handful of men, too few to keep up attacks on the shoreline tribes.

faq.q: What proof of the cull does Guard Thomas require?
faq.answer: Guard Thomas asks for torn fins taken from the lurkers and foragers in Elwynn's eastern waterways.

faq.q: Does Marshal Dughan know about the severity of the murloc problem?
faq.answer: Yes. Guard Thomas says Marshal Dughan is anxious about the murloc threat across eastern Elwynn. Reports of cleared camps matter to local morale.

angles.text: Clearing the waterways protects supply lines and rural homes between Goldshire and the Redridge border.
As a human, you see how thin Stormwind's protection has grown beyond the capital's heartland.
As a hunter, you find marshy shores and reed-lined banks around Stone Cairn Lake suited to stalking nimble aquatic predators that move in swarms.
